# Brief 12: Board pack

Audience: Ironbridge Holdings board of directors, third-quarter meeting.
Decision: approve a $22M expansion of Plant 3 and the quarterly dividend of $0.18 a share.
Format: 10 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds segment results used on slides 3 and 4.

## Facts

F1: Q3 revenue is $312M, up 6.8% from $292M in Q3 last year.
F2: Q3 EBITDA is $58.4M (18.7% margin) against $52.1M (17.8%) last year.
F3: Revenue by segment in Q3 (USD million): Industrial 148, Energy 97, Services 67; last year 141, 92, 59.
F4: EBITDA bridge Q3 last year to Q3 (USD million): start 52.1, volume +4.2, price +3.1, cost inflation -2.4, productivity +1.4, end 58.4.
F5: Net debt is $410M and leverage is 1.8x LTM EBITDA of $228M.
F6: Capex in Q3 was $41M against a plan of $48M.
F7: The total recordable injury rate is 0.9 against a target of 1.1.
F8: Plant 3 expansion: $22M, adds 14% capacity and returns 19% internal rate of return with payback in 4.6 years.
F9: Dividend proposal: $0.18 a share a quarter, a payout of 31% of free cash flow.
F10: Top risks: raw material costs, a customer contract renewal worth $64M a year, a cyber incident, and permitting delay at Plant 3.
F11: Strategic milestones: Energy segment target of $400M revenue by 2028; Services is at 21% of revenue against a 25% target.
F12: Order backlog is $540M, 1.7 times quarterly revenue.
